Gemini is launching new tools to help small business owners save time and get more done. It can now handle tasks like creating brand visuals, organizing messy financial data, and connecting to other apps. These updates let entrepreneurs focus on their passions instead of boring paperwork. Business owners around the world are already using it to grow their companies and solve tricky problems.

Tens of millions of small business owners are using Gemini today to brainstorm future products, manage customer feedback, and analyze business performance. Today, we’re announcing new tools designed to give these entrepreneurs their time back so they can focus on what started it all: their passion.A central hub for small businesses owners, all in GeminiWe’re introducing a new business landing page designed to help small business owners streamline their daily tasks. On-brand visualsBusinesses can now define their brand style in Gemini by uploading their website, brand kit, fonts, or color palettes. When paired with the power of Nano Banana 2.1 (our latest image generation model), Gemini can now deliver end-to-end visual results for new product launches or ongoing marketing campaigns. Gemini retains this visual style, allowing owners to easily generate cohesive, on-brand assets without having to repeatedly upload their style guidelines.

Instead of decoding numbers on their own, small business owners can receive financial insights in a more natural way.Stories from small business owners around the world

In Bordeaux, France, ceramicist Morgane grows her company, Bleu Clémentine, with the support of Gemini. She uses it to write product descriptions, newsletters, and catchy hooks for social media, saving her two to three hours every day — time she reinvests directly into crafting her beautiful tableware and home decor.

In Maharashtra, India, farmer and creator Santosh Jadhav transformed his traditional fields into a thriving ginger farm. With no formal training or local mentors, he used Gemini as his virtual agronomist to evaluate soil suitability, calculate precise seed requirements, and draft a comprehensive investment budget. He shares his tech-driven farming journey online, demystifying AI to show how easily it can elevate everyday agriculture and empower grassroots solopreneurs to integrate technology into their day-to-day businesses.

In Goiânia, Brazil, personal organizer Patricia Morais helps clients bring peace and harmony to their spaces, offering everything from full home organization to digital decluttering. After relocating to Goiânia, she built her local visibility with Google Business Profile and uses Gemini to streamline customer service and content creation — freeing up time to innovate with accessible solutions like clothing QR codes for people with visual impairments.

In Jakarta, Indonesia Gumilang transformed a neglected space under train tracks into Barelz Arena, a vibrant sports and entertainment hub. With no experience in branding or sports, he used Gemini as his strategic partner to create a unique ”Brazilian-street” visual style, design merchandise, and draft brand partnership proposals. Today, this high-energy space brings new life to the area while supporting local job creation and community welfare.

In New Jersey, USA, Josh runs Burger & Butcher, an independent restaurant and retail butcher shop specializing in grass-fed smash burgers, beef-tallow fries, and 100% seed-oil-free cooking. Operating a single location with no dedicated marketing team, Josh uses Gemini and a connected Google Business Profile between shifts to track local search and Maps performance, craft weekend updates tied to neighborhood events, and analyze regional flavor trends to shape a new breakfast program and take-home butcher counter offerings.

The business landing page, marketing and finance skills, and new connected apps are beginning to roll out in the coming days globally for all Gemini app users.And for larger businesses looking to scale AI across teams with centralized administrative controls, advanced data governance, and enterprise-grade security, explore Gemini for your business.
